title: 99sg.c: Rust — root-change detection hook in rpl_stack + node capability re-announce sender
description: Rust mirror of 99sg.a+b. (1) lichen-node rpl_stack: record DODAGID membership transitions when the stack becomes JOINED under a DODAGID different from the last one it joined (see python dodag.py select_parent recording block for exact semantics; drain API, bounded queue, deferred consumption — no under-lock callbacks). (2) Node-side sender: build the announcement using the COSE_Sign1 creation logic in rust/lichen-gateway/src/capability_announcements.rs create_announcement (may need hoisting to a shared crate — coordinate with 7ecb/010x which are touching identity_iid plumbing in the same file) and POST to the new root's /.well-known/capability-announce. Same design nuance as 99sg.b: consider announce-on-fresh-join for root-restart coverage. Tests: unit test the transition recording against DIO sequences (first join, DODAGID switch, same-dodag rejoin, version bump) mirroring python/tests/rpl/test_dodag.py. Independent of python slices.
